title: Let's prototype a JavaScript JIT compiler!
summary: Andreas Kling live-codes a prototype JavaScript JIT compiler for the LibJS engine used in SerenityOS and Ladybird. He builds a standalone bytecode VM, a simple interpreter, and then a simple JIT in about 80 minutes.
why: HN commenters cite it as a concrete example of how a skilled developer uses Copilot, mostly as fancy autocomplete for codebase-specific work.

quote.text: He basically uses it as a fancy autocomplete.
